senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. טָפַח I) hand-breadth, breadth of four fingers joined.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 4b:17">Succ. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ארון תשעה וכפרת ט׳</he> the Ark was nine handbreadths high, and the lid one.
<cite ref="Sukkah 7a:16">Ib. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ שוחק</he> a liberal hand-breadth (four fingers not closely joined). v. <cite ref="A01989"><he>אַמָּה</he></cite>.—
Yoma 55ᵃ top טִיפְחָהּ של כפורת Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 a. Ms. O. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9, ed. עוביה) the hand-breadth, i.e. the hight, of the lid, v. supra.; a. v. fr.—Pl. טְפָחִים, Du. טְפָחַיִים.
<cite ref="Taanit 25b:11">Taan. 25ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr. [<he>טְפָחִין</he>, or <he>טִפְחִין</he>, v. <cite ref="I00649"><he>טְפִיחַ</he> II</cite>.]
